description: USE WHEN you want to know what the market is doing now across 18 category proxies. One call, 18 category proxies (US large-cap + tech, 9 SPDR sectors, developed ex-US, emerging markets, long Treasuries, high-yield credit, gold, oil, Bitcoin): the operational regime, model-conditional regime probabilities on trading day 5 or 21, stress probability vs its baseline, a descriptive forward-return distribution conditional on the regime label, and an equity-factor commonality flag (US sectors re-express one factor). Per cell, only the tier that passed the preregistered out-of-sample rule ships (raw p<0.05, see tier_pvalues; tier_correction shows which survive a multiple-testing correction). No directional forecast. For one asset with as_of support: regime_outlook. Descriptive, not advisory.

detail.description: 'full' (default) or 'summary': summary leaves out the per-row persistence and unconditional baselines and states the forward-return basis and data dates once (about a third smaller; the response lists what was left out).
detail.title: Detail

horizon_days.description: The trading day the probabilities refer to, counted from the data date. Validated: 5 or 21.
horizon_days.title: Horizon Days
